performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of the front channel's 9.8 sq in usable area; 112 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin RKCB46, Cable Capacity Charts

physical.mounting-hardware: #12-24 mounting screws, as shipped with the cover

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships NMF2, cover fitted.

configs.description: The same manager with its cover opened, the finger walls and the channel open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the dual hinged cover opens 110 degrees to the top or bottom without being removed; no view draws a hinge. The cover carries five stand-in hinge knuckles on its top edge and on its bottom edge (their count, size and place are estimated) and is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: the NM2B front-to-rear pass-through blanking panel is a separate accessory (V10404BT-DC) that closes the two windows; it is not drawn and the windows are open.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the blanking panel fitted

gaps.note: no view sections the cover or the fingers: the cover's plate and lips and the stems and crossbars are drawn from the plan view's outline, with their thickness estimated, and the elevations draw the body without the cover's edge.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the NMF2 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP237); the temperatures are the customer drawing's.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of Panduit's Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin (RKCB46) give the NMF2 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum; the figure stated is the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent, 67 (112 at 50 per cent), the cable the FS managers state theirs in. The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable area, 9.8 sq in.

chassis.note: estimated - 444.83 x 88 x 157. The drawing dimensions 482 [19.0 in] over the ears, 465 [18.3 in] between the fixing holes, 88 [3.5 in] high and 157 [6.2 in] deep; the body between the ears is the 444.83 [17.51 in] that the NCMH2 drawing (00787-07) dimensions for the same moulding, which the NMF2 drawing does not, so the width is estimated by that likeness. The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the cover is drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NMF2 customer drawing (Panduit 10404-16) dimensions the channel "5.5 REF [140]" from the front of the cover to the end of the finger zone and the whole manager "6.2 REF [157]"; the mounting plate and its flange are the 17.3 behind. `at` is 139.7, so the ears bolt to the front face of the plate. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of T fingers end-on, the channel between them, and the two windows in the plate at the back of it. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger rows. Its height is the 88 less the two 10 mm rows, 68, estimated; its depth is not drawn (Panduit's calculator gives the usable area, 9.8 sq in, which is 93 mm over that height).

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 157 deep and 139.7 of it stands in front of the rails, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two finger rows, run across the rack; its finger pitch is the 34.925 [1.375 in] that the NCMH2's finger and spacing add up to (25.4 + 9.5, its specification sheet RKSP225) and that the NetManager plan views measure at 34.7 to 34.9. The gap, 5.4, is the slot between two crossbar tips, read off the plan.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn. The end of the manager is the plate, the two finger rows' walls and the cover's edge, built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. Panduit publishes the NMF2 as a customer drawing (PDF 10404-16, with a DXF and a DWG that hold only a trimetric projection of the model, not orthographic views, so they give no measurement), the NetManager High Capacity specification sheet RKSP237, a product page and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The customer drawing's plan view is a vector drawing read at 300 dpi against its own 482 [19.0 in] dimension; the front view gives the windows. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the finger count and pitch, the crossbar, the windows) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate with its two windows, from the front view of the NMF2 drawing, which draws them through the channel; five plates round them, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face so the plate closes the well within the 157 mm envelope. The windows are open: no Panduit document fits a cover to them except the blanking panel NM2B, which is sold separately (see `gaps:`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX, as the FS finger ducts are built. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: the plate on the front view as a well 139.7 deep, whose floor is open at the two windows; the two walls of fingers standing in it; the cover in it across the finger tips, which opens and uncovers the channel; and the back of the plate standing 17.3 proud of the rear face.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the plate and flange 17.3 deep behind the ear plane, twelve stems 100 mm long with a crossbar on each tip, and the cover over the front 12.6 mm. Read at 300 dpi; the stem and crossbar sizes are estimated.

weight.note: drawing - 730 g [1.6 lb], the weight table of the NMF2 customer drawing (10404-16).
